87. What term is used to describe a prolonged
period of sluggish economic activity accompanied
by low interest rates and low inflation, leading to
ineffective monetary policy stimulus?
questions.explanation_english: A 'Liquidity Trap' refers to a situation in which monetary policy becomes ineffective because interest rates are already at or near zero, and savings rates are high. In such scenarios, even with low interest rates, consumers and businesses are unwilling to spend or invest, leading to stagnant economic growth. This phenomenon often occurs during periods of economic downturn when confidence is low, making traditional monetary policy tools less effective.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। 'तरलता जाल' उस स्थिति को संदर्भित करता है जिसमें मौद्रिक नीति अप्रभावी हो जाती है क्योंकि ब्याज दरें पहले से ही शून्य या उसके निकट होती हैं, और बचत दरें उच्च होती हैं। ऐसे परिदृश्यों में, कम ब्याज दरों के बावजूद, उपभोक्ता और व्यवसाय खर्च करने या निवेश करने के लिए अनिच्छुक होते हैं, जिससे आर्थिक विकास ठप हो जाता है। यह घटना अक्सर आर्थिक मंदी के दौरान होती है जब विश्वास कम होता है, जिससे पारंपरिक मौद्रिक नीति उपकरणों की प्रभावशीलता कम हो जाती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Liquidity Trap

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A 'Liquidity Trap' refers to a situation in which monetary policy becomes ineffective because interest rates are already at or near zero.

questions.explanation_english: The statements regarding India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) highlight its foundational components, which include Aadhaar for identity verification, UPI for facilitating payments, and DigiLocker for secure data exchange. List I: (Skill Development & Youth Welfare Program)

Q. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
R. TASK (Telangana Academy for Skill and Knowledge)
S. National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
List II: (Key Objective)
